summary: Ellington Financial Inc. filed an 8-K on October 7, 2026 disclosing that its Board of Directors declared a monthly common dividend of $0.13 per share, payable November 30, 2026 to holders of record as of October 30, 2026. The filing, under Items 8.01 and 9.01, furnishes the related press release as Exhibit 99.1. No advisors, premium, strategic rationale, or structural mechanics beyond the dividend timetable are stated. The event is routine capital-return activity for the mortgage REIT; watch for consistency of the monthly payout with distributable earnings and book value trends.
